validity.researcher_notes: Sheet Status=proposed, last updated 2024-10-17. Multiple independent sources (Marcellus Drilling News 2026-07, EIA 2026-08 release, TVA statements per APPA 2026) confirm pipeline was placed in-service on May 26, 2026, providing 245 MMcf/d throughput via 30-inch diameter lateral. This is a material status change from proposed to operating. FERC CP22-493 order issued 2024-01-18 authorized the project. Construction began late April 2025 after 6th Circuit court ruling lifted stay on Section 401/404 permits. Original in-service target was Sept 2025, achieved May 26, 2026.
